jd_text:
Job Title: Business Development Associate
Department: Business Development
Company: Amperehour Solar Technology Pvt Ltd
Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Pune
Job Type: Full Time
About Us: AmpereHour Energy is one of India’s fast-growing BESS companies, enabling the transition
to a smarter and more sustainable energy future. Founded in 2017, we specialize in delivering end-toend Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) solutions that help make renewable energy more reliable,
efficient, and scalable. By combining engineering excellence with intelligent energy management, we
work across utility-scale, Independent Power Producer (IPP), and Commercial & Industrial (C&I)
projects to solve real-world energy challenges. At AmpereHour Energy, you’ll have the opportunity to
work on innovative technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and help shape the future of clean
energy.
Why join us? • Work on next-generation energy storage and clean energy solutions • Build meaningful
impact in India’s energy transition • Collaborate with passionate teams across engineering, projects,
and innovation • Grow your career in a fast-paced and rapidly expanding organization.
Website: - https://amperehourenergy.com
Job Description:
• Business Development: Identify and pursue new business opportunities in the energy sector.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with potential and existing clients.
• Market Analysis: Conduct thorough research and analysis of market trends, competitors, and
emerging technologies to inform strategic decisions.
• Technical Expertise: Utilize your technical understanding to effectively communicate complex
energy storage solutions to clients and stakeholders.
• Proposal Development: Prepare detailed proposals and presentations, highlighting the
benefits of our technological innovations and solutions.
• Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, project
management, and operations, to ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction.
• Client Engagement: Engage with clientsto understand their needs, address any concerns, and
provide solutions that align with their objectives.
• And any other assignments by Management.
Benefits:
• Competitive salary package
• Health insurance coverage
• Retirement savings plan
• Opportunities for professional development and advancement
• Dynamic and collaborative work environment
